patch_description:
This program is a crossover that combines the best motifs from prior candidates:
- Uses symmetry-based parameter sharing for corners/edges/center to reduce parameter count while encoding board symmetries.
- Keeps the stable CZ lattice entangling backbone.
- Adds shared parametric CRZ "spokes" coupling the center to its neighbors for targeted center-edge interactions.
- Introduces motif-discovery three-qubit ZZZ interactions aligned to the eight winning lines, but shares a single ZZZ parameter ("zzz_line") across all lines to encourage a compact, generalizable motif.

This layout follows the stronger-performing designs: it balances parameter efficiency (shared params, modest N_PARAMS_PER_BLOCK) with targeted expressive building blocks (CRZ spokes and ZZZ winning-line motifs). The EVOLVE-BLOCK markers are preserved and only ANSATZ_SPEC changed so the program's inputs/outputs remain identical.
